text:
(ESA 2022)
Basic Combat Training (BCT) in the US Army
Soldiers in the United States (US) Army are volunteers. The Army trains recruits at basic training units. The main basic training unit is Fort Jackson in South Carolina.
Basic training is nine weeks. The instructors are non-commissioned officers (NCOs). They teach basic military skills, including drill and weapon training.
Recruits in basic training live and sleep in barracks. They wear a military uniform.
They don’t go home during basic training and they don’t see their family before graduation.
According to the text above, we can infer that:
options: Basic Combat Training offers a very comfortable stay for the recruits.
Recruits don’t have weapon training during BCT.
Basic training has the duration of less than one month.
Recruits probably miss their family during Basic Combat Training.
Teenagers in the US Army are obliged to become soldiers when they are 18 years old.
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(A) Basic Combat Training offers a very comfortable stay for the recruits.
Errada.
O texto não sugere conforto.
Fala de disciplina militar: dormem em alojamentos (barracks), sem ver a família por 9 semanas.
Nada indica “confortável”.

(B) Recruits don’t have weapon training during BCT.
Errada.
O texto afirma explicitamente: “They teach basic military skills, including drill and weapon training.”
Portanto, eles têm treinamento com armas.

(C) Basic training has the duration of less than one month.
Errada.
O texto diz “Basic training is nine weeks”.
Nove semanas = mais de dois meses.

(D) Recruits probably miss their family during Basic Combat Training.
Correta.
Baseada em inferência.
Texto diz: “They don’t go home… don’t see their family…”
Natural deduzir que sentem falta da família.
Inferência plausível, exatamente o que a questão pede.

(E) ) Teenagers in the US Army are obliged to become soldiers when they are 18 years old.
Errada.
Texto diz: “Soldiers in the United States (US) Army are volunteers.”
Não são obrigados, é voluntário.
